QuestInfo.name: Truth and Lies
QuestInfo.0: You've uncovered the truth behind Cassandra's missing letter. Gaga has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Gaga, who's suffered the sneezy wrath of the #t4032640#, tells you that Cassandra's cherished love letter, which she's never opened, is actually a break-up letter. He wanted to protect Cassandra, but it's now up to you to either tell Cassandra the truth or not.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra's missing letter incident is over for the time being. Gaga's friendship for Cassandra must be great for him to got to such lengths to protect her feelings. \nWhat's the right choice? Telling the truth knowing that it would break someone's heart, or telling a lie so that she can be happy?\nIt's a tough question to answer.

0.0: If you lie to her, she'll be okay for now, but she might get even more angry if she finds out the truth later... But if you tell her the truth, then she'll be hurt for sure.\nWho can say what's best for her? To tell the truth or keep the secret...

yes.0: Ohh, I can't lie anymore! I just found out what's written in this letter. Cassandra would be so sad if she found out what the letter actually says... That's why I wanted to destroy it before she could read it.\n#b#h0##k, It's up to you. Will you tell Cassandra the truth, or lie to protect her feelings?

no.0: It's not an easy decision, right?
